result.note: A brief bilateral aviation item; one recall question on the partner country in the air-capacity expansion.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, India more than doubled its weekly bilateral flight capacity to over 16,000 seats with which country, after airlines had exhausted the existing rights?
questions.explain: India and Vietnam more than doubled their weekly flight capacity to over 16,000 seats. The expansion came because airlines had used up all the seats allowed under the existing rights.
questions.source: India and Vietnam more than doubled their weekly flight capacity to over 16,000 seats, after airlines exhausted existing rights.
